slot.brief: Expand and evaluate a scalar triple product to test coplanarity or compute volume of a parallelepiped.

verdicts.working: By multilinearity, the bracket is multiplied by the determinant of the coefficient matrix: det[[1,2,0],[0,1,-1],[3,0,1]] = -5. Thus the value is -5×4 = -20.

working:
$[a+2b,b-c,3a+c]=[a,b,c]-6[b,c,a]$; $[b,c,a]=[a,b,c]=4$; hence $-5(4)=-20$.

Independent check: By multilinearity, the bracket is multiplied by the determinant of the coefficient matrix: det[[1,2,0],[0,1,-1],[3,0,1]] = -5. Thus the value is -5×4 = -20.

draft.distractor_notes: B: omits the factor 3 in $3a+c$; C: keeps only the direct $[a,b,c]$ term; D: takes the magnitude instead of the signed scalar triple product.
